<Aside type="tip">
  This is a dump of the data tree from a demo showfile.
  The **Addr** or **Path** can be used in CLI commands or LUA

  Usage in grandMA3 CLI:
  ```lua
  List <Addr>
  -- OR
  List <Path>
  ```

  Usage in LUA:
  ```lua
  local handle = FromAddr("<Addr>")
  ```

</Aside>
